failure.renamePreview: The rename preview could not be prepared. Saved files are unchanged; try again.
failure.renameStopped: The rename stopped before every file was completed. Some files may already have their new names; review the refreshed list, then try the remaining items.
failure.regenerateSlug: A replacement slug could not be generated. Check the Gemini settings, then try again.
failure.renameSlugSave: The rename slug could not be saved. Your edit is still shown; try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.outputFolderDetail: New tasks start with this folder. Leave it blank to save beside each source image.
settings.formatDetail: JPEG always needs a background fill. PNG, WebP, and AVIF keep transparency unless flattening is enabled here or on the task.
settings.jpegEstimate: Estimate source JPEG quality from loaded image bytes
settings.chromaDetail: 4:4:4 keeps the most color detail. 4:2:0 makes smaller files and stays the safest default for broad web compatibility.
settings.estimateDetail: Quality estimation is only used for confirmed JPEG inputs and only while the file is being loaded into memory.
settings.pngPalette: Use indexed palette PNG when possible (256-color style, smaller files)
settings.metadataDefaultsDetail: Used by the Inject metadata op.
settings.apiKeyReplacePlaceholder: Type a new key to replace it
settings.apiKeyKeepHint: Leave this blank to keep the saved key. Type a new key to replace it.
settings.apiKeyWillClear: Gemini API key will be cleared when you save. Type a new key to replace it instead.
settings.noApiKey: No Gemini API key is saved.
settings.generateDescriptionDefault: Generate description for new tasks after save
settings.generateSlugDefault: Generate slug for new tasks after save
settings.defaultWatermarkFontDetail: New text watermark ops start with this CSS font-family string. Choose a preset or type your own stack.
settings.uiFontDetail: The app interface font. Comma-separated families; the first one your system has is used. Blank uses the built-in default.
settings.previewLongEdgeDetail: Sets the working size for live previews and the histogram. Lower values feel lighter; higher values make inspection more faithful.
settings.assetPreviewSizeDetail: Sets the thumbnail size for LUT and stamp picker modals. Smaller values fit more choices on compact screens.
settings.previewDebounceDetail: Wait this long after the latest edit before re-rendering the preview. Higher values reduce churn while dragging sliders; lower values feel more immediate.

settings.concurrentSavesDetail.one: Automatic uses this computer’s CPU count to choose a sensible worker count at runtime. This computer currently reports {count} logical core.
settings.concurrentSavesDetail.other: Automatic uses this computer’s CPU count to choose a sensible worker count at runtime. This computer currently reports {count} logical cores.

about.description: A desktop photo editor for blogging and publication workflows, with queued image processing, metadata controls, rename previews, and optional Gemini-assisted descriptions and slugs.
shortcuts.addOriginalsDetail: Open the file picker to import source images or sidecars.
shortcuts.saveCurrentDetail: Apply the current task’s ops, queue saving, and write the output image plus sidecar.
shortcuts.saveAllDetail: Queue every not-saved task for saving.
shortcuts.renameAllDetail: Review saved and unsaved tasks before renaming saved outputs.
shortcuts.undoDetail: Revert the most recent task edit when focus is outside a text field. Inside a text field, the shortcut uses native text undo.
shortcuts.moveWithin: Move within a list or control
shortcuts.moveWithinDetail: Each list and control is one tab stop: Tab in, then the arrow keys move within it.
shortcuts.jumpEnds: Jump to the first / last item
shortcuts.jumpEndsDetail: Within the focused list or control.
shortcuts.removeOriginalDetail: Removes the highlighted original from the Originals list.
shortcuts.openMenu: Open a menu, then move between items
shortcuts.openMenuDetail: Enter or Space opens the menu; the arrows move between commands and Escape closes it.
shortcuts.gridMove: Move and select in the grid
shortcuts.gridMoveDetail: The picker is a multi-select grid: the arrow keys move and select; {selectAll} selects all.
shortcuts.gridExtendDetail: {extend} grows a range from the anchor; {rangeClick} selects a range and {toggleClick} toggles one item.
shortcuts.gridUseDetail: Applies the one selected LUT or stamp and closes the picker.
shortcuts.gridRemoveDetail: Moves the selected imported files to the system trash. Built-in items are protected.
autoTone.presets: Apply the same clip to shadows and highlights
resize.hint: Resize usually works best near the end of the pipeline.
strip.detail: Strips everything except the selected groups.
unsharp.hint: For output sharpening, place this card after Resize.
whiteBalance.detail: Temperature: blue to amber. Tint: green to magenta.
whiteBalance.sampleActive: Sample active at {x}, {y}. Move either slider to fine-tune.
whiteBalance.sampleHint: Click the preview while this op is selected to sample a neutral point.
startup.corruptSettingsMessage: Your FotoReady settings file was unreadable and a copy has been set aside so nothing is lost.
startup.corruptSettingsDetail: FotoReady has started with default values for the unreadable fields. Your projects and photos are untouched. The saved copy location is recorded in the session log.
startup.failedMessage: FotoReady could not finish opening its settings and workspace.
startup.failedDetail: No photos or project files were changed. Check the session log, then start FotoReady again.
visionError.missingApiKey: Gemini API key is missing. Open Settings and save a key, then retry.
visionError.safetyRefusal: Gemini refused this image because of a safety or content policy restriction.
visionError.unexpectedResponse: Gemini returned an unexpected response. Retry, or adjust the configured model if the problem persists.
visionError.authentication: Gemini authentication failed. Check the saved API key in Settings, then retry.
visionError.modelUnavailable: This Gemini model isn’t available. Open Settings and choose one from the list.
visionError.rateLimit: Gemini rate limit reached. Wait a moment, then retry.
visionError.serviceUnavailable: Gemini is temporarily unavailable. Retry in a moment.
visionError.generic: FotoReady could not analyze this image. The current metadata and saved files are unchanged; try again.
processingError.generic: FotoReady could not save this task. The source and existing saved files are unchanged; try again.
processingError.decode: FotoReady could not read the source image. Check that it is still available and supported.
processingError.process: FotoReady could not apply this task’s adjustments. Review the enabled operations before saving again.
processingError.encode: FotoReady could not create the selected output format. Choose another format or adjust the task before saving again.
processingError.io: FotoReady could not write the output files. Check that the output folder is available, then retry.
processingError.metadata: The image was prepared, but its metadata could not be written. Check the output folder, then retry.
